Radio Person

Cobalt Sword

Ah, a First Aid Kit! Anyone need patching up?
Heads up! Some enemies ahead!
Finally, a real warm-up...
Hey look, it's the Main Shop!
Doesn't look like the White Cake is here...
We should get better weapons.
We're in the past, everything's going to be outdated shit.
I'm sure it'll be fine. We're only 13 years ago.
Lets wait for everyone to be ready before we leave!
Okay! Everyone ready to leave now?
Looks like it, let's get going!
Holy shit, is that Glacium?!
Wow...this must be before he dies.
What was that? Did you say I'm going to die??
Guys!! Don't tell him that!
Die? No, no, we meant we're DYING to meet you!
We're...big fans.
Really? Me? Wow! Usually everyone wants to see my brother.
You bet! Love ice. W element.
Hey, no reason - have you written your will?
It's never too early t-
LAZY!! Uh-we were just wondering, do you know where Gladiatus is?
Oh, uh, yeah, they're on a secret mission right now.
I wasn't allowed to go...
They said I'm not strong enough yet.
But, don't worry! I have an important mission in a few months.
I'm dying to do it!
You should really consider that wi-
Wow, that's so great! It was nice meeting you!
And, Glacium, if there's something you want to do...
You should do it, so you can live with no regrets.
Yeah you never know when you mig-
OKAY BYE GLACIUM! NICE MEETING YOU!!

Villagers will show up at the store and ask for different types of bread.

Now out of my way!
Wait, is she holding...?!
That has to be it! That's the key we've been looking for!
We can't miss this chance!
No, Swan!
We won't need the key anymore, if all goes well.
If we can get through to Gladiatus, then the Tower won't exist!
Should we warn Devi about the Tower?
No, we just need to focus on finding Gladiatus.
Listen here, twig. You either let me through...
...or I'll bury you with the rest of the weeds.

Don't you fly away from me!
When
Big Brother
wakes up...

I don't drive.

But if you fail...
I'll kill every single human that crosses my path!

Thomas

(purrs)

Do you like Ants?

John
] Hey there!

Hey Psy!
What is this building for?
] Gooood morning, ladies and gentlemen!
(They look poor...I'll have to lower the prices.)
How are you?
I still don't forgive you for what you've done to the Bees and the Ants.

] Hey, kid.

(6 Coins)
] Hm? Oh, you're talking to me?
] Wow, nice leggings!
How did this tree get here?
Big Brother?
] Hm.
Hey Ben!
Why are you sticky?
Shouldn't you be in school right now?
] Good morning!
Hey Henry!
Aren't you supposed to be in school?
] You know who I am? Well, I'm glad other Knights of the White Cake are being recognized! It's always just the big 3 of the White Cake that get talked about...

] Well, this shop only had storage for 3 types of armor, so I dropped the Chain Leggings. It's more important to protect your head, chest, and feet - if you're really worried about your legs, you might be able to scavenge some off of a zombie you kill.

] A decent amount, given I'm a member of the White Cake Army. You see, Gladiatus, Devi, and Magum are the big stars who get all the headlines, but there are hundreds of soldiers in the army's ranks. Me, Woria, Norm, the Strength Guard...Sometimes I get a little jealous, but thinking about all the attention usually just makes me glad I'm not them. Not that they haven't earned it - they've all put years of work into becoming as strong as they are now.

] I *was* invited on the mission, but I had some reservations about it. They're out mining Elementium from the Otherside caves ahead - I didn't feel right taking those resources, since the Elementium helped the caves grow as large and full of life as they are. I'm sure we can help a lot of people with what they get, but I just feel wrong stealing it from the wildlife.
] Ha! Yeah, right, and I'm a ghost!
] I like it out here in the forest. It's much more peaceful than it is in town right now, with everyone looking forward to the White Cake's arrival and all.

] Not really. They've done a lot of good, but I've heard Gladiatus' ‘everyone can be a hero' speech more than enough. It's easy to say that when you're as strong as he is, but normal people like us...we can't do much. But I don't get too hung up on that - I just want to enjoy nature.
] Oooh, that's cool. Well, you probably know who I am, then. I bet I'm a celebrity or super rich or something in the future, right?
] Yeah, you just missed them! The White Cake came in, took some photos, Gladiatus gave a speech...but Devi wasn't there. I was most looking forward to seeing her...
] WHAT?! No, I'm just a big fan! She's smart, strong, brave...I want to be like her, but no, I don't like women like that. Besides, there's someone else I'm kinda into right now...
Who do you like?

] Well...he's this hot new teacher that works at the school. Oh my God, it's like he's straight from a movie! I bet all the girls in his class can't pay attention. I tried to flirt with him a little, but he said I wasn't his type...
] Did you get the photo? You DIDN'T?! Then why are you still here?
] Hmm...I would love a photo of Devi, if you could get one. Here's my camera - just take a quick pic of her and get it back to me, hehehe...
] I'm Luna! You could call me an entre-purr-neur of sorts...hehe, get it?” Anyway, welcome to our town! Wanna see what I've got in store?
] Looking to sharped those little kitten claws into some real tiger talons? Buy some Kunai Claws! 100% cat-isfaction, guaranteed!

] The White Cake? Of course I know them, nya! Gladiatus LOVES my special cat cocktail - one time, he drank so much he went absolutely crazy! Galactic star fruit has that quality, I guess. It's got catnip in it, after all! ...Oh! I guess I shouldn't be giving out information like that...

] Of course! Feline genetics run in my family. You should come visit Cat Girl Island some time - we named it ourselves! You can come meet my sister, and my other sister, and my other sister, and my other sister, and my mom, and her sister, and -
Slowly, you tuned out of the conversation...
] Hey! I like the enthusiasm, but...we've never met before. I have no idea who you are!
] They're amazing! Gladiatus is one of my heroes. I hope I can be a brave leader like him when I'm older!
] ...Yeah, they're fine, I guess? Why do you ask?
] Old?! I'm not old, I'm only 30! Th-that's still young, right?!
] I sell Yin Yang Spears! This weapon lets you pull or push enemies around the battle. It's pretty strong - I'd definitely recommend it!
] The White Cake? I admire them, being able to take on such dangerous missions. They risk their lives for the greater good...I can only think of them as heroes.
] It's *Doctor* Ivy now, actually. But hey.

] Really? The only people smart enough to figure out time travel would be either me or Wormhole, and it'd still be hard, even for us...though I guess if Wormhole can figure out how to open that portal...

] Well, I don't mean to brag, buuut...I've actually been working for the White Cake on a top-secret mission!! Actually, funny you ask, since we made this clone of Swa - oops, uh, sorry. I'm not supposed to talk about it, haha.

] Well, I don't mean to brag, buuut...I've actually been working for the White Cake on a top-secret mission!! Actually, funny you ask, since we made this clone of yo - oops, uh, sorry. I'm not supposed to talk about it, haha.

] I'm seeling bandages! I won't always be there to give first aid, and I know how much you fighters seem to always get hurt. Dude, the number of times Gladiatus has shown up all bloody and scarred...I'm genuinely amazed he's not dead yet.
] Hey there! Hello! ...Wait, how do you know my name?

] Yeah! I just recently moved to the Cake Fields. I wanted to start a shop here, but ever since Electrium showed up, things have been a little out of control. He keeps trying to scam people, like someone else I knew... *sigh* I swear, he's gonna be the death of me one day.

] Oh, nothing crazy, just water bottles and batteries. They're perfect if you need a quick boost of healing or more power for your active items! I'd really love to sell badges someday, but we all have to start somewhere!

] The White Cake? They seem like good people, though it's strange to me that everyone in town worships them, considering they're only teenagers. I don't wanna be rude, but would you *really* want to trust the fate of the world to a bunch of grade schoolers? In fact, I'm pretty sure Magum's only a year old!
] ...Is that fashionable in the Cake Fields? I mean, I'm not usually one to follow trends, but if it'll help me fit in...

] Ooh, 'Captain Blossom'? I haven't been called that for a *long* time. It's true, I used to be a pirate, but I retired many years ago once I found a treasure more valuable than any gold or jewels: my son.

] I do! He's currently training away at the Dojo of Glory. All I hope is that he doesn't try to follow in my footsteps of being a pirate. I can't bear to imagine him doing all the stupid, dangerous stuff that I did...
] The White Cake? That's those teen heroes that go fighting in the Cake Fields, right? Oh, to be young again...if I were a younger woman, I might have just snatched that green-haired one right up...
] Why, my name is Eli! My husband and I have lived here our whole life. Our son Thomas is around here somewhere, too!
] Oh, you kids and your crazy fantasies...

] The White Cake? You just missed them - they all came through town today. That Gladiatus is a real charmer, huh? Devi wasn't here, but she's such a beautiful young woman. I wonder when Gladiatus will propose to her...ahh, young love.
] I'm selling Vine Flytraps! They're good for stunning enemies, and are popular with Mages.
] Why do you know my name? And what's with that...smile?
] I didn't run away from home, geez. Rose brought me here to sell some fish we caught.

] The White Cake? I mean, they're fine, I guess? I don't really hang around here much, since I live on the sea. But if they're supposed to be such great heroes, how come only the Cake Fields get protected? Why not the rest of the world?
] The name's John. I live with my family in this nice little town. You must be new around here - I don't think I recognize you.
] Yep. My wife Eli owns a store over there, and my son Thomas is around here somewhere. He likes to just explore the woods by himself.
] They're great! I've seen their stories on the news, and they've saved so many lives. We're lucky to have true heroes like them!
] You know me? Well, if you're here for my bounty, the White Cake already cleared it, so...
] Cool. So am I.

] The humans here built this to worship their god, Kamacete. I don't get it. Are they so bad at fixing their problems, they need to ask some magic sky man to do it for them? Doesn't look like it works too well, considering their history.

] A friend of mine talked about them a lot. I met Gladiatus when he was a bounty hunter - he was way stronger than I was, but he decided to spare me. Said he ‘saw good in my eyes.' They're pretty chill, I guess.

] I've been managing. I lost my job, all my money...but it's fine. I've been at rock bottom before, so I know how to climb back up. I work two jobs: this store here, and this side gig at a circus. The owner's ancient, so I'm trying to get chummy with him - hopefully, he'll leave me ownership when he dies, and I can finally leave this dump.

If you lose without giving it your all, you can tell yourself you didn’t try.
But if you try your absolute hardest and fail… it could break you.
That’s why your body rejected the Elementium.
You’re subconsciously afraid to give it everything.
Well… how do I fix that?
In the next three months, I’m going to train you
so you can use Elementium without it destroying your body.
With this power, even you will be able to defeat Gladiatus.
But you have to understand — this is to save that timeline.
Tell me, Swan… when you first reached the top of that Tower, were you happy?
For a bit, yes.
What about when you made it to the Arced Void, or stopped a war?
For a bit, I was happy. But then I wanted more.
So, will you be happy when you finally defeat Gladiatus?
I will… for a bit. But my climb won’t end there.
Then when will it end?
I don’t know. When I reach the top, I guess.

Floors_Scenes_Heart_Of_Otherside_Startin: ፠Act 1፠
The Introduction
Alright...after months of work, I've finally prepared everything.
This will undoubtedly be our most important mission yet.
The fate of our world rests on the shoulders of —
Aaand why is only Super here?
Well...Swan is climbing the Tower right now, and Lazy is...
Yeah, I don't know where Lazy is.
DAMN IT!!
Looks like Swan's Tower run ended.
...Eroded Catacombs?
Eroded Catacombs...
Hey, sorry guys, I slept in again.
Okay, perfect. Everyone is here.
These new outfits Ben made for us look great!
Alright, I'm here, guys! So how are we gonna stop the world from ending?!
What are YOU doing here?!
And why do you know that?!
Dark Swan told me!
...And why does Dark Swan know?
Uhhhh, well, you see...
Earlier...
I was saving my money for college.
But since the world's ending soon, I spent it all on this TV.
...We don't even have internet here.
...Oh, right...
Wait, what?? The world's ENDING?!
What do you MEAN 'the world's ending'?!
The world's ending?? How long do we have?!
. . .What. . .? The world's. . .ending. . .?!
And then I found out.
IS THERE ANYONE WHO DOESN'T KNOW THE WORLD IS ENDING!?
Barkeep
What!? The world's ending??
God...damn it.
Well, none of that matters anyway...
...because we're going to put a stop to it, right now!
For the past few months, while you were all climbing the Tower, I've been researching.
Look at this - in 2010, those red cracks appeared in Main Shop.
You may notice that the red cracks appeared the same day the Tower rose.
Oh yeah, I remember that!
Stores were closed for a week.
I had to give you guys fish from Kai Islands.
Yeah, and those fish SUCKED.
What I'm trying to get at is...the Tower causes the end of the world!
Oh, I get it! What you're saying is...
We have to keep climbing the Tower!
Look, Quartz came from the future in hopes of preventing this.
Which means the only way we can prevent the end of the world is with her help.
Great, so our only hope is a hunk of metal that's programmed to kill us.
Calm down. I've been trying to read through her code.
There are a lot of studies about time travel saved in her database.
Some were...written by Wormhole.
Our old teacher that got murdered?
I thought he had a heart attack.
You believed that?
It's almost definitely a different person named Wormhole.
But, most importantly, there are instructions on how to build a time machine.
Before, time travel was seen as impossible.
But that was before we discovered this:
A chorus fruit.
Chorus fruits have teleporting properties...
...and mixing it with Elementium allows you to travel through the fourth dimension:
Time itself.
Wait, so how are we gonna find Elementium?
We already have.
It's made of Elementium!?
I thought this shit was supposed to be rare.
Now every boss we fight uses it!
Quartz is powered by a single piece of Elementium.
So I'm using her as a battery and computer.
Are you sure this isn't hurting her?
Simping for the Calculator with an ass, now?
She shouldn't feel anything. I booted her in safe mode...I think.
Bonjour, je suis Quartz! Je suis votre gardien personnel.
Oh yeah, I changed her language by mistake, and I don't know how to fix it.
Anyway, I'm opening a portal to June 2010.
June 2010? Why then specifically?
It's three months before the Tower rises.
That means the White Cake should be active in the area.
We know they were involved with the creation of the Tower, so...
Okay, I get it. So we travel back, ask Gladiatus not to make the Tower...
...then come back to our timeline, where the world doesn't end?
That's the idea, yes.
Hold on - that's not how time travel works.
Since when were YOU an expert?
I—It's just a gut feeling, alright? Calm down.
You might be right, Lazy.
I don't know if changing the past will change our present.
But what can we do except try?
Besides, even if we fail, I still get to fight Gladiatus when he's young.
I heard he was even stronger in his youth...
I can't wait to fight him!
We are not fighting *ANYONE*, Swan.
We're just going to talk.
No! We're not bringing weapons, either.
Oh, and there's one more thing.
I'm a doctor, not a computer scientist, so...
With the code I wrote, we can only stay in the timeline for roughly one hour.
How are we supposed to do this in only an hour??
Well, if we fail, can't we just come back and then time travel again?
What? No! Nevermind, let's just open the portal!
Attention! Tout voyage dans le temps sans l'autorisation du chercheur principal est interdit!
So Moose, you tested this beforehand, right?
Well, no, but...everything's gonna go great!
I mean, hasn't it so far?
Ah, screw it!
They didn't invite me...

Anything for ze one who introduced me to Moose!

(Oh, damn, I actually feel some magic in here.)
(Now I feel kinda weird for taking one...)
(Oh, well. A flower's a flower!)
By ze way, Super...
Do you have any idea when Moose will be here next?
I'd...quite like to see him.

I expected as much, but thank you.
I know ze date was only yesterday...
...but, please, tell him to see me as soon as he can!

Epilogue 6
Moose's Ending
Ah, you're back.
How did things go?
Well...Vivi had a good time.
She liked you, I take it?
Yeah.
And I
still
don't know what to do about it.
Well, Moose, the heart is a complex thing.
Some poets from the early Renaissance period claimed that -
Nelfin. Please. No. Not tonight.
Very well, I'll spare you the history lesson.
But how did
enjoy your date?
She's nice, now that I've gotten to know her.
But I couldn't date her.
You have my memories, right? You know why.
Yes, I understand.
Outside of Vivi herself, though...
Vision actually showed up again.
Vision? The necromancer who disappeared from your camp?
Yep. He was sending skeletons after us all day...
He even shot Vivi and I in the last fight!
Hm. I didn't know he could use a bow.
Though that's not the concern - is Vivi alright?
Yeah, I was able to patch her up. She'll make a full recovery.
But, can I be honest?
I kind of want to just forget tonight for a while.
We've got so much to do, and not nearly enough time...
Indeed. But surely you intend to rest, after the day you've had?
...I can't afford to. We need to keep working.
Shall I summon the rest of the Science Team?
Not now. Ben's probably tired, and I think Quartz is charging.
Very well.
Then, let's get to it - we've not a moment to spare.

ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_14: And it will be fixed in the next update!
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_15: Here is every type of currency in Cake Team Towers.
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_16: Move the mouse to the currency you wish to view.
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_18: Tower Tokens are the main type of currency. They are obtained by completing the Tower and can be spent at the Token Shop on cosmetics, additional dungeons, and items.
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_20:
Cake Coins are the premium currency of this game, they can be obtained from playing but is mostly unlocked from transactions or to patreon members.

They are used to buy cosmetics and other items in the Premium Token Shop

If this is the world download of the normal version, Cake Coins cannot be spent on Premium Items and require the Premium download of the game. In the Premium download, Cake Coins are obtained much faster by reaching the top.
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_22: Every 100 Cake Shards convert into one Cake Coin.
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_24: Kai Coins are a special currency that can only be spent on Kai Island or shops run by Kais
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_26:
Time Gears are used for the Time Keeper quest. Every 100 Time Gears grant a level-up and an unlock. Time Gears are obtained by completing missions or sometimes from Command Boxes.

Max 1500 Time Gears
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_28: Can be used in the Otherside Protectors' shop
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_30: Stat points will boost different types of weapons or abilities,
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_45: you can gain stat points with items, level ups,
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_46: and some characters start with some.
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_31: You can view them in /Trigger ViewStats
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_32: Move the mouse to the Stat Points you wish to view.
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_34:
Red hearts is your normal health, similiar to your MC hearts, although in Towers it appears as a bossbar above your head.

When your hearts hit 0 you die. Your Red Hearts cannot go above your Max HP
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_36: Soul Hearts are like Absorbtion Hearts in Minecraft, they are hearts that can go past your Max HP
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_38: Black Hearts behave the same as Soul Hearts. However losing them causes all nearby enemies to take damage aswell
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_40: Blue Hearts behave the same as Soul Hearts, however they will only last one level and go away every Break Room
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_42:
Class Stat will boost a different stat depending on who you are playing as

Swans Boosts Strength

Check your class passive to see what it boosts
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_44: Strength is how much damage you do with Melee Attacks
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_48: Attack Speed decreases the time between Melee Attacks, and also gives you Stamina Regeneration
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_50: This effects how fast your Stamina Recharges overtime
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_52:
This is how much Stamina you have

Stamina is used for various special abilities that Melee Weapons have
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_54:
Archery boosts the damage of ranged weapons.

Archery also provides Arrows OR Bullets every break room. and Soul Arrows/Bullets too Type /trigger ToggleSoulAmmo to change which one you get
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_56:
Defence decreases the amount of damage you take

20 Defence is the Maximum, any additional Defence is True Armor Instead
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_58:
True Armor subtracts the damage you take based on your True Armor

(Max 75% Damage Reduction)
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_60:
Your Healing stat decides how many health crystals you are given.

Health Crystals is ammo used for Healing Items
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_62:
Regen will make you regenerate Health overtime.

1 Regen = 1 Red Heart Per Second
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_64:
Heal Percent determines how much health you heal after every break room.

The percentage is based on your Max Health, if your Health Percent is 25% and you have 200 Max HP you heal 50 Red Hearts
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_66:
Boosts the amount of healing you receive.

If you have 50 Bonus Healing Recieved and heal 100 damage, you will heal an extra 50 damage
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_68:
Behaves like Defence but only for Fire Attacks

Fire Armor will provide temp fire resistance when you fall in lava or touch fire
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_70:
Behaves like Defence but only for Water Attacks

Also allows you to hold your breath underwater longer
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_72:
Behaves like Defence but only for Electric Attacks

Chance to Electricute nearby enemies when you take damage
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_74:
Behaves like Defence but only for Ice Attacks

Chance to freeze enemies when you take damage
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_76:
Behaves like Defence but only for Dark Attacks

Gain 2 Black Hearts per Dark Armor every Break Room
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_78:
Behaves like Defence but only for Light Attacks

Chance to not take any damage from attacks (% Chance Based on Light Armor Stat)
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_82: How much damage Magic Attacks deal
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_84:
How much Mana you have

Your mana regenerates faster based on how much Max Mana you have (Max 30)
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_86:
How high you jump

If your jump is in the negatives you take damage from jumping
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_88: How much Active Charge you can store
ctt_Lobby_Command_Block_90: How much Active Charge you recieve every Break Room

Also increases Whip Damage

Gives you soul bait per Fishing Stat at the start of each level

having negative starts causing problems

While packing up in the early morning, we were attacked again, this time a bigger fleet came in. Blowing up our walls, throwing their spears at us, we took out most of them but left as there were too many to handle.

It's been quite some time, but we've finally settled in the trees.
Kleem said he saw a fire in the distance.

ctt_Kai_Treetops_Book_13: We woke up and noticed some of our hay supply was gone. Kyree was on night duty and reported two people going in and out.
ctt_Kai_Treetops_Book_14:
Kleem figured it must have been the people who started the fire on the beach, commanding one of the others to visit the camp and get intel.

He did not come back.
ctt_Kai_Treetops_Book_15:
The day after they went missing after exploring the camp, we sent a small militia to spy on them.

During that night we took action and fired shots onto the camp, unfortunately we lost many of our own to whoever these people were.
ctt_Kai_Treetops_Book_16: Enough was enough. We took advantage while they were caught off-guard, sending an even bigger militia to drive them out. We lost many more, but it seemed to work...

We have a sense for despising other kinds.
If you're not a bird like us, don't think we'll be friendly to you.

You are a threat.

The year was 1813.

I walked around like usual. Tending to the garden, greeting my neighbors, paying respects to the people who died to save this town. However, that was short-lived.
ctt_Seized_Town_Book_2:
+=---=+=---=+
A group of... people..? crossed the bridge, but they were holding guns and ammunition.

Shots echoed throughout the town, each house being invaded as I watched through my window, seeing my neighbors get slaughtered.
ctt_Seized_Town_Book_3:
+=---=+=---=+
Although, I was not going down for no purpose... I picked up what I had and began to fight, but it was useless.

One shot fired from the other side of the street, pinning me right in my heart...

...
ctt_Seized_Town_Book_4:
+=---=+=---=+
I awoke on the ground, town abandoned, buildings on fire. I got up, but there was no blood, no wound, nothing... It almost seemed as if the bullet passed through me. I took my cat from my house as I wandered to the forest.

The human body is easy to recreate; however, there is one thing that's impossible to make…A soul.

Each variant I make needs a soul substitute; something I mix with Elementium to create something that mimics a soul. Its affect depends on the item used.

Jelly Sandwich

S.2 has finally decided on a name... SwanJelly

SwanJelly is very underdeveloped.
ctt_Summoner_Book_5:
After the incident I was scared to go full power; so with SwanJelly I used a weak soul substitute and was very careful with him... which means he is developing at an extremely slow rate...

His skin is made entirely out of Jelly- almost like a red slime.
ctt_Summoner_Book_6:
I made him so I could study Swan some more. Turns out Swan is Canadian, although not sure if that will really help us...

Joey bullies SwanJelly a lot- even tried to suck his blood; but Jelly didn't have any...

ctt_Summoner_Book_8: I've decided to clone another Swan- this time with a little more juice. It's dangerous, but they don't call me the Summoner for nothing.
ctt_Summoner_Book_9:
Soul Substitute:
Dark Ring

Age: 10 Days Old


S.3 has finally decided on a name... Dark Swan. This is the fastest a variant has ever decided on a name...
ctt_Summoner_Book_10: It has been 5 years since the incident. Gladiatus warned me to not make another Swan; but after Swan Jelly, I think it's safe to make another as long as I keep an eye on it...
ctt_Summoner_Book_11:
We decided to keep Dark Swan inside. It's risky to let him out during field time...

He's quiet, and sounds sad a lot. The complete opposite of most Swans'; usually they never shut up.
ctt_Summoner_Book_12:
One day he looked me in the eyes and said

"I'm not the original am I"

I- I didn't know what to say, so I just told him no...

I think hes plotting an escape- I always catch him talking with Joey
ctt_Summoner_Book_13: I better keep an eye on him.
ctt_Summoner_Book_15:
Test Subject SU

Vampire Fangs

Age: 50 Days Old


SU has finally decided on a name- he decided his name will be Joey.
ctt_Summoner_Book_16:
Unlike his original copy, Joey has grown vampire fangs. There was an incident where he tried to suck Gregory's blood. Luckily, Devi and Gladiatus were able to break it up.

I should bring cows and pigs for Joey to suck now so that he won't want to eat us.
ctt_Summoner_Book_17:
He has also been obsessed with this anime JoJo's bizarre adventure, which keeps him quite busy throughout the day. He plays this weird JoJo game too.
I never know what he means when he talks about them; but as long as he's happy, whatever.
ctt_Summoner_Book_18:
Dark Swan and Joey seem to get along; however, I think they are plotting something…An escape?

No... Dark Swans too underdeveloped to plan things like that…But I should be careful.
ctt_Summoner_Book_19:
Test Subject G

Soul Substitute: 
Lab Rat

Age #140 Days Old
Test Subject G has finally decided on a name for himself... Gregory.

Gregory hasn't shown any red signs that the last batch has shown
ctt_Summoner_Book_20: Gregory has been regaining memories at a rapid pace. However, I am afraid he might start asking when he can leave. I cannot let him roam around; a variant is too dangerous unwatched. I must be very careful, even though I am certain Gregory will not have any incidents.
ctt_Summoner_Book_21:
Test Subject S

Soul Substitute:

???

Age: 132 Days Old
ctt_Summoner_Book_22:
It has been 132 days, and Test Subject S has yet to speak or do anything. He'll eat his meals... That's about it.

I think using the ??? as a soul substitute was a little much... That item is far too powerful.
ctt_Summoner_Book_23:
It has now been 142 days, and Test Subject S has begun talking. He hasn't figured out a name yet; the first thing he said to me was:

"Tower"

How does he know about the Tower? It's not even built yet?
ctt_Summoner_Book_24:
He opened his eyes and spoke again.

"I must reach the top."

He's freaking me out. The original Swan doesn't know about the Tower; perhaps the soul substitute gave him the knowledge.
ctt_Summoner_Book_25:
He then kept asking me questions.

"What's at the top?"

"Where is the Tower?"

"Can I climb it?"

He has to be connected to the Tower in some way?
ctt_Summoner_Book_26:
At least he's talking now... I am worried, though.

It's a big day tomorrow; the Tower will be built.

I'll have to leave Test Subject S alone for a bit.

Hopefully, nothing goes wrong.
